case: PostgreSQL temporal array app parser and keyed grid edit
contract: The app reads PostgreSQL metadata, parses a grid edit as exact array text, builds the keyed UPDATE with an explicit pg_catalog array cast, and writes date[], time[], timestamp[] and timetz[].
Boundary inputs cover a BC DATE, year 10000, infinities, fractional times, 24:00, maximum finite TIMESTAMP, and timetz offsets ±15:59:59; each array includes SQL NULL.
After each edit, PostgreSQL type text, array text, array_to_json and array_send bytes match a separate native cast oracle; the sibling row remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
A malformed date[] edit reaches PostgreSQL and is rejected with SQLSTATE 22007; the full saved target and sibling rows remain unchanged.

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --locked -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families and consumer paths, temporal array CSV/session cases, and the broader B3 matrix remain open.
